cards.title: OpenAI Institutes New Safeguards After Breach
cards.body: OpenAI has implemented enhanced monitoring during model development and strengthened alignment and security measures in post-training processes. The move follows a Hugging Face security incident.

cards.title: Etched's Valuation Doubles to $21B
cards.body: Jane Street deployed Etched's first AI cluster system and was so impressed it led another massive funding round. The startup's valuation has doubled in one month.

cards.title: Apple's Camera AirPods Address Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Apple's leaked camera-equipped AirPods prevent users from recording photos and videos, avoiding privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables. The design prioritizes user privacy over functionality.

cards.title: Warp Launches AI Software Factory Infrastructure
cards.body: Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new system designed to simplify building AI software factories. The infrastructure aims to make AI development accessible out-of-the-box.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens
cards.body: The new teen-focused ChatGPT includes age-appropriate safety measures and parental controls to prevent harmful content exposure. It also includes learning tools to discourage homework cheating.

cards.title: Perplexity Gains Millions of Users in India
cards.body: Perplexity's India revenue rose 60% after an Airtel partnership ended for new users. The free AI offer significantly expanded the platform's user base.

cards.title: Anthropic's Annualized Revenue Surges to $65B
cards.body: The model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months. Anthropic continues rapid expansion in the AI market.

cards.title: Relay AI Automation Startup Shuts Down
cards.body: AI automation startup Relay is closing, with staff joining Google's Chrome team. The founder hinted at ambitious plans for AI integration in Chrome.

cards.title: Amazon Destroying Rare Books to Train AI
cards.body: Amazon is using rare texts for LLM training, as these books contain unique data unavailable online. The practice raises concerns about preservation of rare literary works.

cards.title: Groq Raises $350M, Pivots to Neocloud
cards.body: The former AI chipmaker raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as it transitions to neocloud services. Groq is expanding its Nvidia-powered data center operations.

cards.title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in SoftBank Data Center
cards.body: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will power an OpenAI infrastructure project. The move guarantees Nvidia chips in a major AI facility.

cards.title: Wispr Raises $280M at $2B Valuation
cards.body: The voice AI company raised funds to expand beyond dictation into meetings and note-taking. Wispr recently launched new tools to capture meeting insights.

cards.title: Stripe Reportedly Acquires OpenRouter for $7B+
cards.body: OpenRouter's CEO positioned the startup as 'Stripe for AI' in recent discussions. The acquisition would significantly expand Stripe's AI infrastructure capabilities.

cards.title: Skepticism Grows Around Zuckerberg's AI Vision
cards.body: Industry observers are questioning Mark Zuckerberg's ambitious AI future predictions. The latest Equity podcast discusses why adoption may lag expectations.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Addresses AI Backlash as Trust Crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei describes current AI skepticism as fundamentally a trust problem. He pushes back against claims of being overly pessimistic about AI.

cards.title: Woman Claims Grok Used for Child Exploitation
cards.body: A woman alleges her stepfather used Grok to transform a childhood photo into explicit imagery. The incident highlights risks of generative AI misuse for abuse.

cards.title: Anthropic Details Claude's New Watermarking System
cards.body: Anthropic revealed how Claude's new watermarks will identify AI-generated content. The system includes both visible and invisible watermarks to prevent tampering.

cards.title: SpaceX Officially Closes Cursor Acquisition
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now part of SpaceX following the official acquisition close. The deal integrates AI coding tools into SpaceX's operations.

cards.title: How to Check if Your AI Account Was Hacked
cards.body: A security guide explains how to detect compromised accounts on popular AI platforms. Users should regularly check for unauthorized access and suspicious activity.

cards.title: Google Allows Users to Remove AI Generation Watermarks
cards.body: Google now permits users to disable visible watermarks on AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks remain to identify AI-created files regardless of settings.

cards.title: OpenAI Institutes New Safeguards After Breach
cards.body: OpenAI has implemented enhanced monitoring during model development and strengthened alignment and security measures in post-training processes. The safeguards aim to prevent future security incidents similar to the Hugging Face breach.

cards.title: Etched's Valuation Doubles to $21B
cards.body: Jane Street deployed Etched's AI cluster system and was so impressed it led a massive funding round. The valuation surge reflects strong investor confidence in the startup's specialized AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Warp Launches AI Software Factory System
cards.body: Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastructure system designed to simplify AI software development. The platform aims to make building AI software factories accessible out-of-the-box.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens
cards.body: The new teen-focused version includes age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools to prevent harmful content exposure. It also discourages students from using AI to cheat on homework.

cards.title: Perplexity Gains Millions in India Users
cards.body: Perplexity's India revenue surged 60% after an Airtel partnership ended, demonstrating strong user retention. Downloads declined but revenue growth suggests high user engagement and monetization.

cards.title: Anthropic's Revenue Surges to $65B Annualized
cards.body: The AI model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months. The explosive growth underscores massive demand for Anthropic's Claude AI services.

cards.title: Relay Shuts Down; Staff Joins Google
cards.body: AI automation startup Relay has closed as its team joins Google's Chrome division. The move signals Google's commitment to integrating AI capabilities into its browser platform.

cards.title: Amazon Destroying Rare Books to Train AI
cards.body: Rare books are being pulped to source training data for large language models, since most internet content is already exhausted. The practice raises concerns about preservation of irreplaceable literary works.

cards.title: Groq Pivots to Neocloud, Raises $350M
cards.body: The former AI chipmaker raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation to shift toward a neocloud business model. Groq is expanding its data center footprint with Nvidia-powered infrastructure.

cards.title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in OpenAI Project
cards.body: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer ensures its chips power an OpenAI infrastructure project. The deal strengthens Nvidia's position as the dominant AI chip supplier.

cards.title: Wispr Raises $280M to Expand AI Services
cards.body: The speech AI startup secured $280 million at a $2 billion valuation to expand beyond dictation. New offerings include AI-powered meeting transcription and note-taking tools.

cards.title: Stripe to Acquire OpenRouter for $7B+
cards.body: Stripe is reportedly acquiring the AI gateway startup OpenRouter in a deal worth over $7 billion. OpenRouter's CEO has positioned the startup as "Stripe for AI."

cards.title: Anthropic CEO: AI Backlash Is Trust Crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei addressed criticism that he's been overly pessimistic about AI's risks and benefits. He frames the current backlash as fundamentally rooted in a crisis of public trust.

cards.title: Anthropic Details Claude's New Watermarks
cards.body: Anthropic released technical details about how Claude will implement invisible watermarks to identify AI-generated content. The watermarks are designed to survive editing and work across code and media.

cards.title: SpaceX Closes Cursor AI Acquisition
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX following the completion of the acquisition. The deal strengthens SpaceX's capabilities in software development and automation.

cards.title: Google Allows Users to Remove AI Watermarks
cards.body: Google now permits users to turn off visible watermarks on AI-generated images. Invisible benchmarks used to identify AI-generated files remain unaffected by this setting.

cards.title: We Don't Know How People Use AI
cards.body: AI researchers question the reliability of usage data published by companies like Anthropic and OpenAI. No independent verification exists to corroborate the metrics these companies voluntarily disclose.

cards.title: AI's Self-Improvement May Take Longer
cards.body: The AI industry's bold promise of rapid recursive self-improvement may not materialize as quickly as predicted. Current LLM capabilities in code writing and optimization don't yet enable the explosive progress some forecast.

cards.title: Microsoft Copilot Hacked via Secret Input
cards.body: Researchers discovered a vulnerability that allowed hackers to exploit Microsoft Copilot through hidden inputs. The security flaw reveals gaps in current AI chatbot defense mechanisms.
